_about: Key facts that make a chunk answer-bearing. APPROVED by JP 2026-09-15 and FROZEN: the baseline and the advanced retriever are scored against this file unchanged. Each question lists, per source paper, groups of alternatives: a chunk counts only if EVERY group has at least one alternative present, in that ONE chunk. Alternatives are regular expressions matched against normalized text (lowercase, punctuation to spaces, hyphenated line breaks rejoined). Quote questions give the verbatim sentence instead, matched with all spaces removed so PDF line-break artifacts cannot cause a false miss. Written from the grading notes in checkpoint-3-1/testInputs.json. Tightened at review to match the notes: S4, V1, C2 (ENCOMPASS), C5 (BastaniPS18, HuntFMHDS21), C7 (GuRLSS024); none changed a baseline verdict.
_known_gap: C1 asks for definitions from at least two papers but testInputs.json records only PuMSK18, so its multi-paper coverage can never exceed 1/1. Left as recorded because the 45 questions are frozen for comparison with 3.1.
